title: Iinkwenkwezi Ezilishumi Elinanye Ezaqubuda
intro: Umntu othile kwiQuran wanikwa umbono onzulu ebuntwaneni — iphupha lezidalwa zasezulwini ziqubuda ngentlonelo. Iminyaka yayiza kudlula kungcatsho, ukwahlukana, ukutyholwa ngobuxoki, nokuvalelwa entolongweni ngaphambi kokuba lo mbono uzaliseke. Ngubani lo mphefumlo unamandla onebali elithatha isahluko eside kwiQuran?
clues: Ndakha ndaselula, ndisikelelwe ngephupha elimangalisayo endandilumkiswa ngutata ukuba ndiligcine liyimfihlo.
Abazalwana bam, bemfanyekiswe ngumona, baceba ukundihlasela baza bandiphosa emngxunyeni onzulu nomnyama.
Ndathwalwa ndasiwa kwilizwe elikude ndaza ndathengiswa endlwini yegosa elihloniphekileyo, apho ndafumana khona inceba ndaza ndaphakama ndaba noxanduva.
Ukutyholwa ngobuxoki kwakhokelela ekubeni ndivalelwe entolongweni ngokungekho sikweni, kodwa kuloo ndawo imnyama ndafumana intuthuzelo ngomthandazo nokuqubuda ku-Allah.
UAllah wandisikelela ngesakhono esingaqhelekanga sokutolika amaphupha, nto leyo ekugqibeleni yandizisa phambi komlawuli welizwe yaza yandiphakamisa ndaya kwisikhundla esiphezulu sokuthenjwa.

Emva kweminyaka emininzi yokwahlukana, ndaphinda ndadibana nosapho lwam endiluthandayo, kwaye iphupha lam lobuntwana leenkwenkwezi ezilishumi elinanye, ilanga, nenyanga zindikhothamela ekugqibeleni lazaliseka.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
